left.raw_text: at least one measurable lesion (other than bone)

right.raw_text: if previously irradiated has demonstrated progression since the radiation therapy

left.raw_text: no major impairment of renal or hepatic function

right.raw_text: AST, ALT<2.5X ULN (<5 X ULN if liver metastases are present)

right.raw_text: short acting somatostatin analogues must be judged to be on a clinically stable dose by the investigator prior to study entry
